input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: We searched the full Agreement for most-favoured-nation, "no less favorable", best-terms, right-to-match and price-benchmarking mechanics and found none. The commercial terms (Section 5 revenue share by Exhibit, and the Winning Bid Price floor at Section 3(j)) impose no obligation on AP to extend Kubient any terms it gives third parties or to match third-party offers, and Section 1 expressly confirms AP remains free to sell Inventory through other agents or directly. This sits at the preferred position (no Customer MFN obligation), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
